scenes.title:

scenes.detail: Zoom in. Zoom out. Isolate the selected object.
scenes.narration: Zoom in on what matters. Isolate a selected element. Check its data without losing the context of the building. Make every review easier to follow.

scenes.title:

to your standards.
scenes.narration: Our vision takes that workflow further. Use A I to suggest standard mappings, ask questions about objects, and review the proposed data before accepting a change.

scenes.title:

scenes.narration: Imagine asking: which objects need a closer compliance review? Connect the conversation to the current model, inspect the evidence, and keep your team in control of the decision.

scenes.narration: For modeling and cost estimation teams, clearer data means a stronger starting point. Inspect properties, capture review issues, and export a spreadsheet for the next stage of your workflow.
